description: High-quality answer criteria for the Performance Review - Evaluation Getting Started interview. Formal employee self-evaluation in preparation for a review conversation.

terms.label: Role Scope & Evaluation Context
terms.description: The responsibilities, ownership areas, priorities, and expectations the performance should be evaluated against during the review period.

terms.label: Goals, Expectations & Success Measures
terms.description: The goals, deliverables, and success measures that mattered most and how clearly they were communicated or understood.

terms.label: Results & Business Impact
terms.description: Outcomes achieved and the value those outcomes created for customers, teams, or the organization, with supporting evidence.

terms.label: Execution, Ownership & Reliability
terms.description: Follow-through on commitments, prioritization, accountability, and consistent, reliable delivery of responsibilities.

terms.label: Quality & Craft
terms.description: Accuracy, completeness, thoroughness, professional standards, and care applied to work products and decisions.

terms.label: Communication, Collaboration & Professionalism
terms.description: Clarity, responsiveness, coordination, trust, and effectiveness when working with the manager, peers, and stakeholders.

terms.label: Judgment, Growth & Readiness
terms.description: Decision quality, self-awareness, learning, adaptability, development, and readiness for broader responsibility.

terms.label: Context, Fairness & Next-Period Expectations
terms.description: Contextual factors, constraints, resources, and fairness considerations relevant to a balanced evaluation, plus expectations to clarify for the next period.

responseProfile.stance: Performance consistently falls materially short of expectations.
Performance has meaningful gaps and requires focused improvement.
Performance reliably fulfills the expectations of the role.
Performance significantly and consistently surpasses expectations.

primaryQuestions.question: During this review period, what role responsibilities, priorities, and expectations should your performance be evaluated against?
answerGuidance: Your current role/title or functional position during the review period
The responsibilities, ownership areas, or priorities you believe should be evaluated
The expectations or success standards you believe applied to those responsibilities
Any temporary projects, expanded scope, or special assignments that should be considered
Any changes in role scope, ownership, or priorities during the review period
Any responsibilities or expectations that were unclear or interpreted differently

highQualityCriteria.requirement: States current role/title or functional position during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more core responsibilities, ownership areas, or priorities that were part of the role during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each responsibility, ownership area, or priority in concrete, understandable terms.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies the role expectations, success standards, or contribution level the employee believes should apply to those responsibilities.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes recurring responsibilities from temporary assignments, special projects, or expanded scope.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies any meaningful changes in role scope, ownership, priorities, or responsibilities during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains why those role, scope, ownership, or priority changes occurred.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Notes any uncertainty, disagreement, or ambiguity about which responsibilities should be included in the evaluation.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: What goals, deliverables, or success measures were most important during the review period, and how clearly were they understood?
answerGuidance: The goals, deliverables, priorities, or success measures that mattered most
How success was supposed to be measured or recognized
Any targets, deadlines, standards, or expected outcomes tied to those goals
How clearly those expectations were communicated or understood
Whether expectations changed during the review period
Any goals that were formally assigned versus informally understood

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more goals, deliverables, priorities, or success measures that were important during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each goal, deliverable, priority, or success measure in concrete, understandable terms.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains why each listed goal, deliverable, priority, or success measure mattered to the team, customer, organization, or role.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: States how clearly the expectations or success measures were communicated or understood during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites measurable targets, deadlines, quality standards, customer outcomes, or other evidence-based success indicators.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes goals that were formally assigned from goals that were implied, evolving, or informally understood.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies any goals, deliverables, or success measures that changed during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how changes to goals, deliverables, or success measures affected performance expectations.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: What results or business impact did you deliver during the review period, and what evidence best supports your view?
answerGuidance: The most important outcomes, accomplishments, or contributions from the review period
What specifically was achieved, improved, delivered, stabilized, or solved
Why those results mattered to the team, customer, organization, or role
Evidence that supports your view of the impact
Actions you personally took that contributed to the outcomes
Results that met, exceeded, or fell short of expectations, and why

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Lists one or more results, accomplishments, outcomes, or meaningful contributions from the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each result, accomplishment, outcome, or contribution in detail.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains why each result, accomplishment, outcome, or contribution mattered.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Connects each result, accomplishment, outcome, or contribution to one or more relevant goals, priorities, responsibilities, or expected outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites measurable results, metrics, deadlines met, customer outcomes, business outcomes, or other evidence of impact.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides examples of actions personally taken that contributed to the result or impact.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Highlights results that exceeded, met, or fell short of expectations and explains why.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Connects results to team, customer, department, operational, financial, or organizational outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: How consistently did you follow through on commitments, manage priorities, and take ownership of work during the review period?
answerGuidance: How reliably you followed through on commitments, deadlines, and responsibilities
Examples of ownership, accountability, prioritization, or proactive problem solving
Where execution was especially strong or inconsistent
Any missed, delayed, reprioritized, or escalated work and why it happened
How much direction, oversight, approval, or support was needed
How your execution affected team progress, customers, or business outcomes

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes how the employee followed through on commitments, deadlines, deliverables, or responsibilities during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more examples that demonstrate ownership, accountability, prioritization, or reliability.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how those examples affected work progress, team outcomes, customer outcomes, or manager confidence.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: States whether execution and ownership were consistent, uneven, improving, or constrained during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies commitments, deadlines, or responsibilities that were missed, delayed, reprioritized, or escalated.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains the reason missed, delayed, reprioritized, or escalated work occurred.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides examples of proactively identifying risks, solving problems, or escalating issues early.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes work the employee owned independently from work that required manager direction, approval, or cross-functional dependency.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: How would you describe the quality, accuracy, thoroughness, and professionalism of your work during the review period?
answerGuidance: The quality, accuracy, thoroughness, and professionalism of your work
Examples of deliverables or work products that show your quality standard
Whether quality was consistent, improving, uneven, or constrained
Any errors, rework, missed details, or quality issues and what caused them
Evidence that supports your view of quality
Training, tools, time, review processes, or support that affected quality

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes the quality, accuracy, completeness, thoroughness, or professionalism of the employee's work during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more examples of work quality, craft, technical skill, accuracy, or attention to detail.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how each example met, exceeded, or fell short of the quality standard expected for the role.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: States whether work quality was consistent, uneven, improving, or constrained during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Cites evidence such as reduced rework, error rates, stakeholder feedback, audit results, review outcomes, or deliverable acceptance.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies any errors, missed details, rework, quality issues, or preventable problems that occurred.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains the causes of any errors, missed details, rework, quality issues, or preventable problems.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Notes any training, tools, time, review process, or support that affected work quality.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: How did your communication, collaboration, and professionalism affect your performance during the review period?
answerGuidance: How you communicated with your manager during the review period
How you communicated and collaborated with peers, customers, contractors, or stakeholders
How updates, feedback, meetings, handoffs, and escalations typically worked
Communication or collaboration practices that helped performance
Communication or collaboration issues that created friction, delay, confusion, or negative outcomes
Examples and causes of communication successes or breakdowns
Improvements that would support stronger collaboration next period

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes typical communication with the manager, including clarity, responsiveness, transparency, tone, preparedness, or follow-through.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes communication or collaboration with peers, customers, contractors, stakeholders, or cross-functional partners.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how coordination, updates, meetings, handoffs, feedback, or escalation typically happened.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies communication, collaboration, or professionalism practices that supported positive outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies communication, collaboration, or professionalism practices causing breakdowns, friction, delays, confusion, or negative outcomes.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more examples of how communication, collaboration, or professionalism positively affected an outcome.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides one or more examples of how communication, collaboration, or professionalism negatively affected an outcome.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains the causes of one or more communication, collaboration, or professionalism breakdowns.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: How did your judgment, learning, adaptability, and professional growth develop during the review period?
answerGuidance: How your judgment, learning, adaptability, independence, or coachability developed
Examples of applying feedback, adapting to change, or making stronger decisions
How your growth affected performance or readiness for broader responsibility
Development areas, judgment gaps, or readiness gaps that remain
Support, coaching, training, mentorship, exposure, or stretch work that would help
Which development areas should be prioritized next, and why

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more areas of judgment, learning, adaptability, independence, coachability, or professional growth demonstrated during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each area of judgment, learning, adaptability, independence, coachability, or professional growth in concrete, understandable terms.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how each area of growth affected performance, role effectiveness, team outcomes, or readiness for broader responsibility.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more development areas, judgment gaps, learning needs, or readiness gaps that remain.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides examples of applying feedback, adapting to change, making better decisions, or becoming more independent over time.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains what support, coaching, training, mentorship, exposure, or stretch work would help address remaining development needs.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Distinguishes current-role growth from readiness for expanded scope, advancement, or next-level responsibility.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Prioritizes which development areas should be addressed next and explains why.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

primaryQuestions.question: What context, constraints, resources, or fairness considerations should be taken into account when evaluating your performance, and what expectations should be clarified for the next period?
answerGuidance: Contextual factors that affected performance during the review period
Constraints involving workload, staffing, tools, systems, timing, market conditions, or cross-functional dependencies
Fairness considerations, including whether expectations or comparisons were applied consistently
How context affected results, execution, quality, communication, or growth
Expectations, priorities, or success measures that should be clearer next period
Support, resources, or changes that would make future performance evaluation more accurate and fair

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more contextual factors, constraints, resources, or fairness considerations that affected performance during the review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Describes each contextual factor, constraint, resource, or fairness consideration clearly and concretely.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains how each contextual factor, constraint, resource, or fairness consideration affected results, execution, quality, communication, or growth.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Identifies one or more expectations, priorities, support needs, or success measures that should be clarified for the next review period.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Provides examples of staffing, workload, tools, systems, market conditions, inherited challenges, timing, or cross-functional dependencies that affected performance.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Compares the employee's circumstances to peers, comparable roles, prior periods, or expected resource levels when relevant.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Explains whether performance should be interpreted differently because of constraints, resource levels, changing expectations, or unusual conditions.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation

highQualityCriteria.requirement: Suggests concrete next-period priorities, support, resources, or success measures that would make evaluation clearer and more fair.
highQualityCriteria.label: Performance Review Evaluation
